title: OVision A raspberry Pi powered portable low cost medical device framework for cancer diagnosis.
summary: Full PMC article reports a Raspberry Pi portable deep-learning device classifying ovarian-cancer histopathology subtypes at 95% accuracy with patient-level holdout splits.
